$comment: Starling context snapshot, v1 (E19): the authorized-at-activation
context a mode decision may consume. Superwhisper's documented failure
mode is app context arriving from a LATER active window after
recognition; Starling therefore freezes the relevant target/context at
activation (before audio leaves on the frozen ASR route), revalidates
against this exact snapshot at delivery, and never re-resolves against
whatever window is active after ASR.
Data-only: this document cannot encode permission elevation. It is a
frozen RECORD of what an adapter already provided and which bounded
source kinds were already granted (granted_sources is an enum of
kinds, not free-form strings, so it cannot name or add new grant
targets). It contains no field that can add context sources, providers,
routes or scopes; preauthorization happens in runtime/user policy
before capture, never inside a snapshot. A grant revoked while
inference is pending must be honored before any further transmission.
Expiry: expires_at bounds the snapshot's validity. Target identity and
selected content must refer to the same activation snapshot; a take
that outlives expires_at re-snapshots rather than reusing it.
Capabilities: adapters declare what they can actually provide
(selection, document versioning, content digest, conditional apply).
An unavailable capability is declared false, never pretended - an
adapter that cannot provide a reliable compare/apply must not
advertise atomic replacement (delivery falls back to preview).
Selection ranges carry a declared offset encoding (utf16, utf8_bytes or
unicode_codepoints); consumers must not assume one unit system.
Secure fields: when secure_field is true the snapshot must NOT carry
selected_text (and typically no target). This exclusion is structural:
the document is a oneOf of a secure snapshot (const true, no
selected_text property at all) and an open snapshot (const false), so a
secure snapshot with selection contents is schema-invalid under both
jsonschema and the repo's minischema fallback.
Keyword subset: only keywords minischema.py understands are used (the
candidate's if/then/not exclusion was rewritten as the equivalent
oneOf; format: date-time and prefixItems/maxItems were replaced by
patterns and minItems). The exact 2-element range shape and the 8000-
character selected_text bound are additionally enforced by the
executable oracle tests/mode_routing.py.
